criteria.requirement: Repair built-in utils.envwrap boolean inference for actual bool/Optional[bool] annotations, bool defaults and explicit types fallback. Parse case-insensitive stripped true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off, reject unknown/empty text clearly with parameter name and preserve direct-call argument precedence. Do not turn string-typed "False" into bool, change int/float/union inference or evaluate symbolic annotations as code. Keep environment-name prefixes/app precedence and external optional envwrap provider delegation untouched; this delivery targets the pinned built-in provider. Validate with isolated patched synthetic env keys only, no real credential/config changes.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
